method: Built-in image_gen for graphic authoring; deterministic nearest-neighbor/palette conversion and animation compilation thereafter.
final_lettering_prompt: Edit only the second line of this transparent pixel logo to improve NATIVE small-resolution reading. Keep the first Chocobo’s lettering identical. On the second line put exact text 'Mystery Dungeon' in the SAME bold playful chunky style but with MUCH clearer simple complete letters, open counters, less rotation, an unmistakable lowercase r after e in Mystery, an unmistakable n after u in Dungeon. Clear separation between every letter and a visibly wider word space between Mystery and Dungeon. Compact title intended to read at just 156 logical pixels wide. Do not add decorative details that confuse letters. Keep the same four flat olive grayscale tones and one-pixel darkest outlines, no smooth gradients or antialiasing. Keep true transparency. Do not add anything. Upper line retains feather flourishes; lower line prioritizes precise readable stylized pixel glyphs in the same visual family.
backplate_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied native WonderSwan title screen to create its CLEAN BACKPLATE for a localized logo. Remove ONLY all Japanese title lettering across lower middle y56..99 logical pixels, the tiny TM and the 'for' plus Japanese subtitle y105..117. Reconstruct the engraved dark stone arch/ring and dark empty interior that were concealed behind the large lettering. Keep the stone arch silhouette and its original bottom at logical y101. Preserve the original bird face and its beak, the entire Chocobo portrait, upper carved arch, all pixels in upper y0..55, margins and light olive blank background exactly. Do not add new letters. Do not add any typography or characters. Do not draw the bird's full body behind text: the lower part of ring is a dark interior empty behind the replacement logo. Same 224x144 logical screen composition as input, enlarged 6x nearest-neighbor to 1344x864, chunky EXACT pixel grid. Only four original flat colors #242400 #9292AA #B6B6AA #DBDBAA, no smoothing, no gradients. Output is a clean blank logo backplate with the original upper Chocobo peeking through the arch.
note: Prompt constraints did not guarantee exact generated pixels, dimensions or palette. Only the compiled assets meet the measured pixel and palette constraints. The generated bird was not accepted as a replacement for the original animated frames.
